notes.title: Indie Assemble
notes.content:
Hello everyone! How are you today?

We're here to announce that [b]CrafTAE[/b] is in the first edition of the [b]Indie Assemble[/b], the global indie game celebration hosted by [b]Excaliber[/b]! 😄

The initiative will feature [b]over 1,000 indie games created by more than 600 development studios from 63 countries[/b]: titles already available or coming in the next few months, ready to join the libraries of millions of players! Whether you are into action, adventure, racing, platformers, horror, survival, card games, point-and-click adventures, strategy titles, or idle games… Indie Assemble has something just for you!

📚 Discover brand-new releases, epic journeys, and hidden gems in this worldwide showcase of indie creativity!

If you want to know more about it, here are some useful links:

[list]
[*] Website: https://excaliber.it/en/
[*] Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100089284557850
[*] LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/excaliber-di-giorgio-catania/
[/list]

The event will be live on Steam  from [b]May 5, 2025, at 10:00 AM PT (7:00 PM CET) until May 11[/b] at the same time. 🕒

Here is the official Indie Assemble link:

https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44717737/sale/IndieAssemble


[b]UNITED WE STAND![/b]

Leave a like and share your thoughts in the comments below!

[h1]And remember—the CrafTAE DEMO is FREE, you should play it![/h1]

Have a good game! We’ll be back soon.

Cheers!

#indieassemble

notes.title: Dungeon Cards
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! I hope everything is going well.

Potyguara here again from [b]mappe[/b], and today I’m talking about [b]Dungeon Cards[/b] in CrafTAE 🃏.

There are currently [b]9 dungeon cards[/b] ⚔️ in the game and they are filled with creatures from the CrafTAE universe, Terra Ænsãhna. Join our [b]Discord[/b] if you want to learn more and follow the game’s development progress!

Here’s the link:

[url=https://discord.gg/dmnWEFzyNg]TAE Discord[/url]

The goal of a run is to defeat the dungeon by facing different kinds of enemies that spawn in waves.

Each dungeon has [b]3 difficulties[/b]: Basic, Advanced, and Expert.
[list]
[*] Basic has 6 enemy waves;
[*] Advanced has 12 enemy waves;
[*] Expert also has 12 waves, but with an added dungeon trait to increase the challenge!
[/list]
👿 More waves mean more enemies—and stronger ones!

If you're curious, check out xThuka’s gameplay where he clears the Goblin Hole on Basic difficulty:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vo_vMwJNtsw

Now for some [b]great news[/b]!

CrafTAE will be participating in the [b]Indie Assemble[/b] festival from May 5th to 11th, hosted by [b]Excaliber[/b].

Visit their website for more details:

[url=https://excaliber.it/en/]Excaliber[/url]

Leave a like and share your thoughts in the comments below!

[h1]And remember—the DEMO is FREE, you should play it![/h1]

Have a good game! We’ll be back soon.

Cheers!

notes.title: Biome Cards
notes.content:
Hello to all of you! Hope everything is good.

I'm Potyguara, from mappe and I'm here today to talk about biome cards in CrafTAE 🃏.

There are currently 10 biome 🌳 cards in the game. They are:

• Plains
• Forest
• Mountains
• Kalforj
• Suverforj
• Kisilforj
• Libershor
• Nor'Linn Selend
• Willnea
• Orcelia

Each biome corresponds to a region in the CrafTAE universe, called Terra Ænsãhna. Join our discord if you want to know more about it.

Here is the link:

https://discord.gg/dmnWEFzyNg


Anyway, there are some basic resources like [b]WOOD[/b], [b]STONE[/b] and [b]BERRIES[/b], which dictates the basic gameplay of the game. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock biomes containing unique materials, such as [b]IRON[/b]. That will allow you to go further in the game, building iron structures and crafting iron equipment. The same applies to other biome cards. Each one has its own characteristics (resources), as described above.

That means a lot of [b]replayability[/b], given that you have a lot of ways to obtain the same goal, which is to defeat the dungeon, making use of 300+ cards in the game.

If you are curious about it, check out this no commentary gameplay from FullThrough. He played through the tutorial and a basic difficulty run.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1aQBx9G406M

[h1]The DEMO is free, you should play it![/h1]

Have a good game! We'll be back soon.

Cheers!
